modules.module_title: Ensure scene safety while responding to an emergency

pcs.pc_description: check if the scene is safe for oneself, victim and bystanders by identifying potentially hazardous items, individuals or environments at the scene
move the victim away from source of injury to safe area to prevent further danger such as during road traffics, snake/dog bites, fire, eye splash and drowning
position the victim in comfortable posture keeping the injured body part immobilized
ensure all tight clothing is loosened and environment is conducive, illuminated & ventilated
seek assistance of trained lifeguard or trained swimmer to extricate the drowning person
keep oneself calm while responding to the emergency
reassure the victim
triage the victim(s) in case of mass disasters as per standard protocol and arrange their transport to nearest healthcare facility accordingly
inform the local emergency service provider as per type of emergency situations such as Emergency Medical Service (EMS) team, ambulance, police, fire brigade, etc.
identify if assistance from bystanders needs to be taken
arrange alternate transport of the victim to nearby healthcare facility timely and carefully, in case EMS team is unreachable
convey incident details to emergency response services accurately
assess the victim for any limb deformity, swelling, coughing, bleeding, or breathing difficulties
check if the victim is awake and conscious by asking the victim to identify point where it exactly hurts after incident
check for the victim’s response to sound and touch (Tap and Talk) and signs of life, if victim is apparently unconscious
reassess the responsiveness every 1 to 2 minutes until help arrives

modules.module_title: Ensure self-safety before providing first aid care

pcs.pc_description: wear personal protective equipment for self- safety as per availability
maintain hand hygiene by washing with soap/alcohol based sanitizers
introduce oneself to victim for obtaining permission (if responding) before providing first aid
position the individual and oneself appropriately for applying external chest compression and/or ventilation safely and effectively
perform Cardio Pulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) as per standard procedure
evaluate the individual's respiratory function and the effectiveness of chest compressions and ventilation
carry out the procedure until the help arrives or individual regains airway and circulation

modules.module_title: Provide first aid care to the victim complaining of medical emergencies

pcs.pc_description: assess and record breathing difficulty/patterns, abnormal facial expressions, deficit in speech, any weakness, warning signs of convulsions, cyanosis, the pattern and duration of fits
obtain information from the victim if on any medication or treatment in case of chest pain/discomfort
perform CPR only if victim loses consciousness, stops breathing and complains of chest pain
provide Heimlich maneuver or abdominal thrust for dislodging an obstruction from a person's windpipe in case of choking in adult victim
provide back slaps in between the shoulders of infant by placing the infant in one hand in case of choking
ensure nothing is given orally to the semi- conscious victim
support the victim to protect from falling down and rest his head and shoulders with a makeshift pillow in case of paralytic attack/stroke
position the victim in lie down posture with foot end elevated or sit with his/her head between their knees in case of giddiness/fainting
clear all nearby objects that may cause injury while victim is shaking in case of fits or convulsions
check if jerky movements of victim could be avoided to prevent fractures
ensure that swallowing, speaking, sniffing, spitting, coughing and blowing nose is avoided in case of nose bleed
pinch the soft part of nose and clean dribbling from nose with a clean cloth in case of nose bleed/epistaxis

modules.module_title: Provide first aid care to the victim of trauma emergencies

pcs.pc_description: ensure that the movement of victim is restricted in case of penetrating injury by objects like knife, metal or glass pieces as well as immobilization of bitten limb
ensure that no penetrating object is removed from the wound
apply direct pressure on bleeding site with a clean cloth and tie it directly over it, if bleeding profusely
apply splints or any other available substitute to stabilize the broken segments, in case of fractures
cut off loose burnt clothes
soothe the burnt area by either immersing it in cool water/under running water or covering it with a clean cloth
remove encircling tight clothing and jewellery from the bitten limb to prevent constriction
clean the snake/dog bite site with soap and running water after wearing plastic cover or gloves to decrease infection

ensure that tying any tourniquet, giving herbal medicine, sucking venom out of limb, elevating the area to heart level and unnecessary limb movement or physical activity of victim is avoided in case of bites
obtain information about the snake, if possible without comprising on self and others safety

follow standard protocol while providing first aid care in case of eye injury such as looking for any foreign object in the eye, rinsing the eyes immediately using normal water and covering the eye with a loose cloth
ensure that putting any ointment in the eye, pressure on the eye dressing and rubbing of the eyes are avoided in case of eye injury
follow standard protocol while providing first aid care in case of drowning such as covering the victim with a blanket, assessing them for breathing and consciousness
ensure that water is not taken out from stomach or lungs actively in case of drowning
